activity_summary: The jaw is no better for yesterday's house. You do not go to the barber. You do not name a day for going. Tonight is not the morning you will spend on it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the jaw was unchanged, and did not go.

entities.name: the tooth
entities.context: Mentioned in No better for fame

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A hush is not a cure.
